answer: One concrete defense is stake-gated reputation, like a harbor master checking papers. Picture an agent economy as a busy wharf: a new agent with no job history docks at the outer moorings and must post a small bond while it builds a track record. A sybil farm spawning hundreds of identities must bond each one, turning cheap identity inflation into real cost. Honest old agents hold the pearl of trust and can vouch for newcomers only up to their own stake, so fake clusters never outrank established attesters. Slashing the bond on fraud makes attack economics collapse.
